title: Abbas ka maidan
body:
Abbas ka maidan
Ghazi ki shahaadat se, saadaat pe kya guzri
(Maula ki qamar tuti, zainab ki rida utri) x2
(Abbas ka maidan mei ghore se utar naa) x3 Shabbir se pucho kabhi zainab se khabar lo
(Are khaimon mei yatimon ke piyaalon ka bikharna) x2
